unmaintained.evidence: Last publish 2016-08-13, over 24 months ago; deprecated on npm ("Use destructuring assignment syntax instead."). OSV lists GHSA-p6mc-m468-83gw (CVE-2020-8203) against 4.4.0. Repo is the lodash monorepo, which is still active; deadness is judged from last publish date.

permissiveLicense.evidence: MIT (npm registry license field of the pinned version)

weeklyDownloads.evidence: About 2.2M downloads in the last week (npm downloads API)

pureFunction.note: Single exported function pick(object, ...paths), declared with two parameters; the paths are rest arguments (function.length is 0). No I/O, timers, randomness or network.

originalTestSuite.label: not available
originalTestSuite.detail: The published 4.4.0 tarball contains no test files. Tests live in the lodash monorepo and are not adapted here.
